description: NIE Networks Open Data Hub is an open data portal listed in NIE Networks Open Data Hub, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by NIE Networks Open Data Hub. The portal lists 20 datasets published by NIE Networks Open Data Hub for Northern Ireland (NIE Networks distribution area); the ones about transport, energy, water and digital networks are catalogued as records of their own, the others (population, health, culture, budgets and similar) are outside the scope of this catalogue. Coverage: Northern Ireland (NIE Networks distribution area). 20 datasets are listed in the catalogue that this harvest read; 6 of them are about infrastructure and became records of their own. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is set per dataset on the portal. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support finding infrastructure data of this area. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-nienetworks-portal.
licence: set per dataset on the portal
